android_fork_merge.status: Merged into the fork as a normal merge commit; the upstream PR was still open when reviewed.
android_fork_merge.notes: Compose launcher, JNI bridge and :game process split merged on top of the Android 0.7.7 baseline. Later account, wardrobe and input fixes were preserved. The fork adds Minecraft installation import/repair and an artifact-only dev workflow.

base_selection: Best matching first-parent revision; 309 revisions compared
review: Integrated the published 2026-11-01 nightly, not the moving main branch. Reconciled 26 conflict files across rendering, EventLoopCtl/splitscreen wrappers, keyboard focus, native content hooks, sandboxed hmod runtime and account session recovery. Preserved Android system DNS, IME/import-picker SAF, launcher-selected graphics, lifecycle return, optional worker/cache limits and fixed opt-in mod bundle; the Horizon DocumentsProvider was later removed in favour of the in-app Game files browser. GLES terrain packs all current varying fields and lowers colored-light nested arrays without changing uniform bytes; Vulkan now additionally adapts the reviewed opaque/cutout terrain optimization, with ordering guards and shader/LOD/culling fallbacks; the merged upstream baseline is unchanged. Kept deployment workflows disabled. ARM64 Clippy, optimized ARM64/ARMv7 builds and targeted input/content/account/GPU tests passed. Tablet Vulkan Compatibility world, inventory, Home/resume, launcher return and provider root were exercised. Final F-03L GLES retest is recorded in docs/android-0.7.7-testing.md; other ABIs and final release APKs still need validation. No blanket resolution of low-end crashes or performance reports is claimed.

candidate_upstream_release.status: Reviewed candidate only; not merged or Android-validated

accounts_appearance_review.notes: Reviewed newer account-save reporting and desktop encrypted-file storage changes. Android retains its Keystore AES/GCM store and reports sign-in save failures through the existing shared task. The selected stable nightly baseline is unchanged; no experimental UI branches were merged.

engine_merge.status: Merged into an isolated dev branch; not promoted to android or main.
engine_merge.conflicts: 88 conflicted files resolved: upstream base kept, fork/Android wiring reapplied. Upstream split its gameplay library and changed the mod API; the Android cdylib compiles the shared gameplay source twice and needed generated API files plus crate-root shims.
engine_merge.checks: cargo metadata --locked, tools/check_public_tree.py and CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo check -p horizon-android --offline pass (exit 0, warnings only). Full build, CI APK and device verification not yet done.
engine_merge.preserved: Android shared-storage default and journaled migration, .hnmod loader/trampoline, Compose launcher, offline names/accounts, deployment workflows disabled.

feature_integration.status: Merged onto the engine branch in feature/integration-2026-11-13; compile-checked, not device/CI verified.
feature_integration.checks: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo check -p horizon-android --offline -j1 passes (exit 0). horizon-trampoline unit tests pass (4/4).
